statement.excerpt: In total, OpenAI’s expenses to Microsoft amounted to $17.2 billion.
statement.document_title: Exclusive: OpenAI Losses Increased Nearly 8X in 2025, With Spending Hitting $34 Billion

from_speaker: $6.047 billion charge related to “cost of revenue”
our_interpretation: The surrounding paragraph supplies calendar 2025 as the period.
Expenses means amounts recognized for Microsoft services, without assuming that all were paid in cash during the year.
The total should round to $17.2 billion at one decimal place; the cost-of-revenue component should round to $6.047 billion at three decimal places.
The cost-of-revenue component is part of the observation, not a conditional forecast.
The accounting basis is company_reported because Zitron attributes the amounts to company financial documents.
criteria.support_condition: Independently verified 2025 disclosures establish approximately $17.2 billion in total expenses to Microsoft, including approximately $6.047 billion classified as cost of revenue.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable disclosures establish that either the total or the cost-of-revenue component differs beyond the stated rounding precision.
